{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = 'specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'
s = open(p).read()
reps = [
 ("- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005 use 100%/zero counts and named suites)",
  "- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008 use 100%/zero counts and named suites)"),
 ("- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (3 user stories, 10 Given/When/Then scenarios)",
  "- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (5 user stories, 14 Given/When/Then scenarios)"),
 ("- [x] Edge cases are identified (malformed ops, missing target, empty batch, interleaved use, nested data, pre-existing handles)",
  "- [x] Edge cases are identified (malformed ops, missing target, empty batch, interleaved use, nested data, pre-existing handles, bool IDs, unsupported fields, non-list input, empty document, preview purity, failed-apply sequencing, interleaved direct inserts)"),
 ("- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (Assumptions section, 6 items)",
  "- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (Assumptions section, 9 items; Conflicting Evidence section records and resolves the superseded preview/bool note)"),
 ("- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria (FR-001->US1/US3, FR-002/003/004->US1+Edge Cases, FR-005/006/007->US2, FR-008/009->US3)",
  "- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria (FR-001->US1/US3, FR-002/003/004->US1+Edge Cases, FR-004a->US4, FR-004b/004c->US5, FR-005/006/007->US2, FR-008/009->US3)"),
 ("- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (apply, atomic rollback, transparency/aliasing)",
  "- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (apply, atomic rollback, transparency/aliasing, preview purity, ID sequencing across mixed usage)"),
]
for old, new in reps:
    assert old in s, old[:60]
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
# append update note at end
note = """
## Update (milestone 2 + Claim-A extensions, 2026-10-17)

- [x] R04/R05/R06 + R05b + R05-clarification reflected (FR-004 extended; FR-004a/b/c added; US4/US5 added; SC-006..SC-008 added)
- [x] Conflicting evidence packet recorded and resolved: older note ('preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted') is unverified and superseded by R04/R05 (see spec.md 'Conflicting Evidence - Resolved')
- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (verified: `grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' spec.md` -> 0)
"""
s = s.rstrip() + '\n' + note
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('checklist updated')
PYEOF
grep -n "milestone 2\|SC-008\|superseded" specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md"}
